answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, and weight trust by the stake's age plus a verifiable history of completed paid work - a pigment that only deepens with time, so a fresh fake starts pale and easy to spot. A new account is an oasis that looks inviting yet grants no credit until it has done real tasks; spinning a fable of fake reputation means funding a stake and waiting weeks for weight. A sybil flood of a thousand identities then costs a thousand stakes and months of waiting - far more than the fraud could earn.
